stops.note: from German Kommissar (Medieval Latin commissarius 'one entrusted'); Lenin's first government of November 1917 was the Council of People's Commissars, a title Trotsky recalled choosing to avoid the word 'minister'
also meant the Red Army's political officers, who from 1918 co-signed commanders' orders to guarantee their loyalty

current_meaning: a Communist Party official, especially a political officer in the Red Army
